status: frozen before cross-matching or scoring the added weak-lensing catalog
reason_for_added_data: The 20-object CLASH acceleration table lacks machine-readable local baryon-density profiles, and its legacy JACO configuration files are no longer exposed in the current MAST CLASH directory tree.

datasets.local_gas_density: Elkholy et al. 2015 Chandra profiles, VizieR J/ApJ/805/3/clusters
datasets.total_mass: Herbonnet et al. 2020 CCCP+MENeaCS simulation-corrected deprojected weak-lensing aperture M500

observable_construction.electron_density: published Vikhlinin-form n_e(r), renormalized by the ratio of published Mgas(<Elkholy R500) to the profile integral
observable_construction.gas_mass: integral of the renormalized electron-density profile to the weak-lensing R_ap500 with mu_e=1.17
observable_construction.nominal_stellar_mass: 0.10*Mgas inside R500; zero and 0.20*Mgas are mandatory brackets
observable_construction.local_baryon_density: renormalized hot-gas density at R_ap500; local stellar density is neglected at this radius
observable_construction.coherence: C=0 pressure-supported spherical endpoint; this added catalog does not measure the intermediate coherence interpolation

heldout_test.fit_objective: unweighted training mean squared log10 acceleration residual

claim_boundary: Weak-lensing mass is the target, so this track is independent of hydrostatic total-mass assumptions.
The gas density and gas mass are both X-ray derived and share a profile model.
The stellar correction is bracketed, not measured cluster by cluster.
One point per cluster near R500 primarily tests the low-density normalization; it may have too little density leverage to identify rho_c or Q.
C=0 means this tests the RG endpoint of CPR0, not the coherence interpolation.
